name: Download the opt-out list as a CSV file
description: Download the opt-out list as a CSV file Stream the opt-out list for a category as a CSV file that can be re-imported as-is. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/messaging_preferences/export_opt_outs_csv/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/messaging_preferences/export_opt_outs_csv/
Stream the opt-out list for a category as a CSV file that can be re-imported as-is.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: category_key (query) — Message category key to export. If omitted, exports recipients opted out of all marketing messages.
